children: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals in San Francisco has blocked Kalshi
from offering sports event contracts tied to the lands of two California tribes, Reuters reported.

The court said the contracts violated the federal Indian Gaming Regulatory Act and the tribes' (Blue Lake Rancheria and Chicken Ranch Rancheria of Me-Wuk Indians) own gaming ordinances, the report published on Wednesday noted.
Additionally, the ruling comes as a setback for Robinhood Markets
, which stands to lose substantial business if it can't ​route customers' event contract orders through Kalshi, according to the newswire.

title: US court blocks Kalshi from offering sports event contracts tied to two California tribes - report
